meta.title: The Long Border — a podcast on Mētis
meta.description: A gardening podcast on the new Mētis theme in its deep-green Ogygia style: the latest episode up top, every episode a real post, the two hosts, and where to listen.
meta.author: jamiemarsland

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
update_option( 'gogh_booted_as', 'metis-podcast' );
wp_set_current_user( 1 );
try { wp_trash_post( 1 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
try { wp_trash_post( 2 ); } catch ( \Throwable $e ) {}
wp_update_user( array( 'ID' => 1, 'display_name' => 'Ruth & Tomasz', 'nickname' => 'Ruth & Tomasz' ) );
wp_update_term( 1, 'category', array( 'name' => 'Notes', 'slug' => 'notes' ) );
$def = json_decode( base64_decode( '' ), true );
$r = gogh_site_def_boot( $def );
if ( is_wp_error( $r ) ) { error_log( 'gogh metis boot: ' . $r->get_error_message() ); }
